question: Can an exact predecessor-signed rotation revocation be prevented from predating the exact rotation packet it claims to revoke without claiming globally trustworthy time?
falsifier: Any authoritative exact-match revocation with revocation.issuedAt < rotation.issuedAt producing ROTATION_REVOKED or clean usability would falsify the bounded rule.

fixture_accounting.reason: The causality assertions extend the existing exact key-rotation-revocation fixture rather than adding a separate counted protocol case.

truth_boundary: The check compares two canonical timestamps already signed into the exact supplied packets. It proves only that the revocation packet was not signed earlier than the rotation packet it names; it does not prove external clock truth, synchronization, global freshness, or global ordering.
